validation.textLength.en: The text length does not meet the requirements.

validation.option.en: Choose a supported option or format.

validation.range.en: The value is outside the allowed range.

http.serviceUnavailable.en: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

http.notFound.en: The record is missing or inaccessible.

http.invalidRequest.en: The request format or action is invalid. Try again.

http.versionConflict.en: Another action updated the content. Reload before continuing to edit.
